verdict.rationale: Antigravity ships a Python Agent SDK and a headless CLI, so versioned APIs and a deprecation policy are a fair question for this product. However, the evidence pack documents no API versioning scheme and no deprecation policy. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, and the changelog items cover only UI features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
